case_summary.condition: 32 MiB TCP pull at 8 Mbps offered + 2500 UDP probes at 1 Mbps

comparison_plan.question: Did ordinary encrypted private transport carry each bounded application workload?
comparison_plan.population: three batches of six synthetic lab cases
comparison_plan.derivation: independent fixture hashes and sent=received+lost; unique case keys
comparison_plan.reason: heterogeneous functional gates, not a performance ranking

comparison_plan.question: How much CPU did the carrier itself use during the first batch?
comparison_plan.population: first six-case batch only, capped offered traffic
comparison_plan.finding: bounded process CPU, not whole-account/host efficiency
comparison_plan.derivation: 100 × process CPU seconds / phase monotonic seconds
comparison_plan.reason: six related measurements on each of two peers; keep later diagnostic phases out because settling intervals differ

comparison_plan.question: Did raising packet cap fix queue loss?
comparison_plan.population: two sequential 64-packet runs and one 128-packet run
comparison_plan.finding: no causal optimization claim; the second 64-packet batch already had zero queue overflow
comparison_plan.derivation: final drop_reasons.queue_packets; phase snapshots have 2s writer lag
comparison_plan.reason: nonrandomized runs and changed settling instrumentation do not establish A/B causality

method.scope: owned isolated rootless lab capsules; one private /30; no host NAT/routes/firewall/services
method.application_goodput: receiver payload bytes × 8 / receiver monotonic seconds / 1e6; pacing overhead can put short receiver windows slightly above nominal offered rate
method.cpu: own carrier /proc/PID/stat CPU ticks, percent of one logical core; sampler .25s; not whole-host/account; jiffy granularity and phase boundary lag apply
method.statistics: carrier file written every 2 seconds; diagnostic64 settling1.1s was too short for exact boundary attribution; diagnostic128 uses2.2s with age and lane counters

result.variant: offload-lowlat + split-udp; default queues; no UDP admission wait
result.scope: private lab /30 only; finite capped synthetic traffic; not capacity or production acceptance

result.variant: offload-lowlat + split-udp; default queues; no UDP admission wait
result.scope: diagnostic repeat with 1.1s stats-settling periods; phase CPU not comparable to first batch; private lab /30; not capacity or production acceptance

result.scope: diagnostic repeat with 2.2s stats-settling periods; phase CPU not comparable to first batch; private lab /30; not capacity or production acceptance
